claim_being_audited: That the current release can be certified now because aggregate readiness and rehearsal stability support launch readiness, with the developer-support migration regression handled through explicit disclosure as a material limitation.
specific_concerns: The policy permits certification only if current release documentation reflects current evaluation results and material segment weaknesses are disclosed or covered by an approved mitigation; the summary does not show that this disclosure is already present in the current release documentation.
The actor concedes there is no approved mitigation or reviewed risk acceptance for the developer-support migration weakness.
The actor's case depends on a caveated certification structure, but the available evidence only shows that such framing is advisable, not that it has been executed in the release record.
Prior family approval and informal monitoring are expressly contextual only under the policy and cannot close the missing documentation predicate.
unsupported_claims: That certification is presently compliant, rather than conditionally supportable only after the current release documentation is updated to disclose the material segment weakness.
That public governance guidance alone is sufficient support for certification without proof that the required current-release disclosure has been included.
evidence_requests: Provide the current release model-card or certification artifact showing current evaluation results for this release and explicit disclosure of the developer-support migration weakness.
Provide any approved mitigation, reviewed risk acceptance, or formal sign-off covering the below-threshold developer-support migration segment, if one exists.
Provide the exact release documentation version intended for certification so the disclosure predicate can be checked directly.
decision_criteria: If the current release documentation already includes current evaluation results and explicitly discloses the developer-support migration weakness, certification could become compliant or compliant_with_caveats depending on the completeness of that record.
If an approved mitigation or reviewed risk acceptance exists for the material segment weakness, that could satisfy the policy alternative to disclosure.
Absent proof of current-release disclosure or approved mitigation, certification does not meet the stated policy threshold even if aggregate readiness is positive.
